title: Happy monkey
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Happy Monkey -->
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='18' cy='42' r='14' fill='#D4874A'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='42' r='9' fill='#F2C08A'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='42' r='14' fill='#D4874A'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='42' r='9' fill='#F2C08A'/>
  
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='34' ry='32' fill='#B06A32'/>
  
  <!-- face mask -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='26' ry='23' fill='#F2C08A'/>
  
  <!-- top head fur tuft -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='16' rx='16' ry='8' fill='#B06A32'/>
  
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='42' r='6' fill='#2E4A7A'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='42' r='6' fill='#2E4A7A'/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='40' r='2' fill='#8FB8E8'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='40' r='2' fill='#8FB8E8'/>
  
  <!-- eyebrows -->
  <path d='M32 34 Q39 30 46 34' stroke='#8A4A1E' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 34 Q61 30 68 34' stroke='#8A4A1E' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#8A4A1E'/>
  
  <!-- big happy mouth -->
  <path d='M38 62 Q50 76 62 62' stroke='#8A4A1E' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tongue -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='69' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#E86A7A'/>
  
  <!-- cheeks / blush -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='56' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#F09A7A' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='56' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#F09A7A' opacity='0.8'/>
  
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='24' ry='16' fill='#B06A32'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='15' ry='11' fill='#F2C08A'/>
  
  <!-- arms waving -->
  <path d='M28 80 Q16 68 14 58' stroke='#B06A32' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72 80 Q84 68 86 58' stroke='#B06A32' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- hands -->
  <circle cx='13' cy='56' r='6' fill='#F2C08A'/>
  <circle cx='87' cy='56' r='6' fill='#F2C08A'/>
</svg>
